name: Attach to a meeting
title: Attach to a meeting: a task's Google Doc, Sheet or deck attached to the invitation of a meeting you organise about it, in one press from the task's Documents
aliases: put the document on the meeting

events.opened: You pressed Attach to a meeting on a document in a task's Documents
events.attached: You pressed Attach, and the task's document went onto a meeting's invitation

permissions: reads the events of your own calendars in your Synapse Master, from today to two weeks ahead, that you organise
reads whether the meeting has the document attached already, and adds it to the invitation's attachments only when you press Attach, emailing nobody and sharing it with nobody
touches.remove: Turn the switch meeting_attach off on its row in Evolution, Mutations: no button is drawn and the route refuses. To remove it for good revert night 31's meeting_attach commit (rouh/meeting_attach.py, rouh/web/meeting_attach.py and its route in rouh/project/urls.py, its button and the Documents section drawn for it in rouh/task_docs.py, the doc_attach relay in rouh/static/app/cards.js, its handler in rouh/static/taskpage.js and rules in taskbrowser.css, Calendar.attach in rouh/google_api/calendar.py, this manifest).
